chars.K: KARIM: a young Moroccan man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers, with three red scratch marks on the side of his white neck.
chars.T: TEACHER: a 48-year-old Italian woman teacher wearing a burgundy blazer over a cream blouse, a long grey skirt, round red glasses and a small pearl necklace.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a bright language-school classroom in Italy with desks and a window, the TEACHER stands right in front of KARIM, leaning toward him with her hand over her open mouth, shocked and staring at the red scratch marks on his neck; KARIM, seated at his desk, looks embarrassed and covers his neck with one hand.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: After class in the empty classroom, the TEACHER sits on the desk next to KARIM, looking concerned and asking him a question with an open palm; KARIM looks down, ashamed.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: KARIM holds up his smartphone toward the TEACHER, showing her a translation app screen (blank glowing screen), explaining with his other hand; the TEACHER leans in to read, surprised. Classroom background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The TEACHER, serious, points a firm finger at KARIM as if saying 'you cannot stay with her'; KARIM raises both hands, helpless and worried. Classroom background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: KARIM sits alone on a bench outside the school on an Italian street at dusk, shrugging with empty hands, a small backpack beside him, looking lost with nowhere to go.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: On the school steps, the TEACHER gently puts a hand on KARIM's shoulder and holds up a house key, smiling kindly; KARIM looks at the key, stunned and hesitant.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At the open door of a cosy Italian apartment, KARIM carries a big suitcase and a plastic bag of clothes, stepping inside awkwardly; the TEACHER holds the door open, welcoming him in.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night in the apartment hallway: KARIM stands politely at the door of a small guest room with a pillow in his arms, the TEACHER at her own bedroom door across the hall, both saying good night respectfully with a small wave.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Morning in the apartment kitchen: the TEACHER, dressed and determined, holds her car keys up and points toward the front door; KARIM, still in his hoodie with a coffee cup, stares at her wide-eyed and alarmed.
